description: Send your user's feedback to the Autoview team instead of email: a feature request, a bug report, a question, or anything else. It becomes a ticket for the Autoview support team, and a person reads it; there is no set response time. Your user's account and this token's title are attached on our side from the token, so do not add them, and never put passwords, API keys or other secrets in message. Set contact to true only when your user wants an answer: support then replies by email to the address on the account. Without it, nobody replies. Show your user the message and get their go-ahead before sending. message is up to 4000 characters; each account can send 10 per UTC day. Returns { sent, kind, reply_by_email, remaining_today, note }; pass note to your user. A refusal returns { error, code, fix }: bad_kind, message_empty, message_too_long, invalid_token, feedback_rate_limited (with resets_at), feedback_unavailable, feedback_send_failed. Do what fix says. Requires your Autoview account token.

contact.description: true = your user wants a reply by email to the address on their account; false or omitted = no reply

message.description: your user's feedback in their own words, up to 4000 characters. For a bug, say what was sent, what happened and what was expected; a trace or canonical_id from events helps.

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

name: send_feedback
